description: This file contains functions and types for managing session tool result messages, including size truncation, normalization, and guarded appending to session transcripts. It implements a guard to handle oversized messages and synthetic tool results within a session management context.

methods.name: capToolResultSize
methods.description: Truncates oversized tool result messages to a maximum size, appending a warning suffix if truncated.

methods.name: trimNonEmptyString
methods.description: Trims whitespace from a string and returns undefined if the string is empty or not a string.

methods.name: normalizePersistedToolResultName
methods.description: Normalizes the toolName field in a toolResult message, providing fallbacks and default values.

methods.name: getRawSessionAppendMessage
methods.description: Returns the unguarded appendMessage function from a session manager.

methods.name: installSessionToolResultGuard
methods.description: Wraps a session manager with a guard that handles oversized messages, synthetic tool results, and message validation before appending messages to the session transcript.
